what: First end-to-end token through our own code, with the real 19.5 GB checkpoint
why_this_document_exists: Until now every number in this repository was a projection or a single-layer probe. No token had ever been run through our implementation. The budget tables in decode_budget.py and the release notes describing 12.5-25.1 tok/s are calculations, not measurements, and this file exists so the two can never be confused again.

prior_state.what_those_numbers_were: analytic. bytes-per-token arithmetic applied to a measured kernel bandwidth of 64.4 GB/s. Never validated by a running model.
prior_state.kernels_that_had_run: kernel #1 (NVFP4 GEMV) in isolation, and one real MoE layer through the numpy oracle. Nothing above layer scale.

measured.hardware: 2x Tesla T4, 15.64 GB each, 33.7 GB host RAM

output.verdict: DEGENERATE. Real Inkling produces coherent text. Repetition of one phrase and twelve identical colons means at least one stage is numerically wrong, so the 0.15 tok/s is a speed measurement of a broken model and must not be quoted as Inkling throughput.

comparison.why_the_gap_is_not_the_kernel: 6.84 s/token is ~1500 python-level operations per token (48 layer visits x ~30 ops) plus a per-visit dtype cast of layer weights. The Triton kernel itself runs at 64.4 GB/s in a tight loop. Rewriting the kernel cannot move 6.84 s; removing per-op overhead can.

bugs_found_by_running: SiTU self-check asserted 4.0 where SiTU gives 100
attn_res.attn_queries has 23 entries indexed by layer-1, not 24
rel_logits_proj is [16, 1024] and contracts over d_rel, not its transpose
relative attention bias is per query head, not per KV head
the KV einsum ignored GQA grouping entirely
attention gate is per element (3072), the sink per head (24)
attention-residual addend was applied twice at a block boundary
sm75 cannot represent fp8 at all: Triton refuses to compile until scales are raw uint8
attn_res returned one vector instead of one per query row
global layers store the conv weight [4, D], local layers [1, 4]
attn-res queries were on cuda:0 against sources on cuda:1
every expert read expert 0's activations for the down projection
cross-pass queries are (core_layers, 4, H), one set reused on every pass
controller weights are bf16 against an fp32 h
Triton launches on the current device, not the tensor's: cuda:1 layers ran on cuda:0
